description: Implementation of the Overlay class and related functions for ANGLE project, managing overlay widgets and rendering overlays.

classes.name: OverlayState
classes.description: Holds the state of overlay widgets, including enabled widget count and widget list.

classes.name: Overlay
classes.description: Manages overlay rendering, widget updates, and environment-based widget enabling.

classes.name: DummyOverlay
classes.description: A dummy implementation of overlay, possibly for testing or fallback.

methods.name: Overlay::init
methods.description: Initializes overlay, sets up widgets, and starts timing.

methods.name: Overlay::enableOverlayWidgetsFromEnvironment
methods.description: Enables overlay widgets based on environment variable.

methods.name: Overlay::onSwap
methods.description: Updates FPS counter and per-second widget data on buffer swap.
